title: Write agency integration tests
description:
Create tests/test_agency.py with pytest-based tests covering the scheduler, check-in generation, notification queue, initiative controls, and the agency API endpoints. Use starlette TestClient against a FastAPI app that includes the agency_router. Mock database calls and external context lookups.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/agency/__init__.py (created by task a.1)
- chatbot/agency/scheduler.py (created by task a.1)
- chatbot/agency/checkins.py (created by task a.2)
- chatbot/agency/notifications.py (created by task a.3)
- chatbot/agency/initiative.py (created by task a.4)
- chatbot/db/models.py (updated by task a.5)
- chatbot/api/agency.py (created by task a.7)
- chatbot/api/app.py (updated by task a.7)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY tests/test_agency.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Implementation:

1. tests/test_agency.py with four test classes: TestScheduler, TestCheckInGenerator, TestNotificationQueue, TestAgencyAPI.
2. Test fixtures: test_app constructs FastAPI app with agency_router and yields starlette TestClient. test_user_id fixed string. scheduler preloaded with test events.
3. TestScheduler: test_should_initiate_never returns False; test_should_initiate_quiet_hours returns False; test_get_next_event returns earliest; test_add_remove_event; test_run_loop_stops_on_event.
4. TestCheckInGenerator: test_generate_never_returns_none; test_generate_reminders_ok_for_reminders_only; test_generate_emotional_none_for_reminders_only; test_generate_returns_checkin; test_dispatch_routes_correctly; test_get_recent_context_empty_catches_error.
5. TestNotificationQueue: test_enqueue_never_gated; test_enqueue_reminders_only_types; test_dequeue_fifo_order; test_poll_filtering; test_pending_count; test_unknown_id_read; test_unknown_id_dismiss.
6. TestAgencyAPI (using TestClient): test_get_initiative, test_put_initiative_valid, test_put_initiative_invalid_400, test_get_notifications, test_get_notifications_with_since, test_mark_read, test_dismiss, test_mark_read_unknown_404, test_dismiss_unknown_404, test_trigger_checkin, test_get_schedule.
7. All tests use mocks for database calls. No real Postgres, Redis, or LLM providers.
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_agency.py exists with four test classes: TestScheduler, TestCheckInGenerator, TestNotificationQueue, TestAgencyAPI
TestScheduler covers should_initiate, get_next_event, add/remove, and run_loop stop
TestCheckInGenerator covers initiative gating (never, reminders_only) and successful generation
TestNotificationQueue covers enqueue gating, dequeue order, poll filtering, pending_count, and unknown-id handling
TestAgencyAPI covers all seven endpoints including 400 and 404 error cases
All tests use mocks for database calls and external dependencies
No test requires a running Postgres, Redis, or external service
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: require a running Postgres, Redis, or external service for test execution
call real LLM providers or embedding services
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use starlette TestClient for API tests
use pytest fixtures for app, scheduler, checkin_generator, and notification_queue
use unittest.mock.patch for mocking initiative and database calls
assert on response JSON shape, status codes, and method return values
forbidden: call real LLM providers or embedding services
require a running database server for tests to pass
add integration tests that require network access
use pytest-asyncio decorators that require an event loop plugin
